# KLT Cyber Church — Copilot Instructions

This project's working instructions (monorepo layout, commands, coding conventions, design system norms, authorization model) live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repo root. Read it first.

Product behaviour (requirements, roles, features, data rules) is defined in [`spec/SRS.md`](../spec/SRS.md) — the single source of truth. If code and the SRS disagree, that's a bug to flag, not to silently resolve either way.
